decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established dumper range, it likely stays because early uncertainty is tolerable and its fit with existing engineering, sales and service resources makes it easier to meet aspiration levels over time.

This articulated construction dumper is also near the core business, so management would usually continue it while learning from the first market feedback rather than abandon a related launch after only a short trial.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the established offer, it faces a higher risk of failing to meet aspirations, but the firm's technical capabilities and some organizational slack still make continued testing more likely than immediate withdrawal.

A compact telescopic loader introduced as a multi-model product line signals stronger commitment and resource backing, so management would be inclined to retain and refine it unless results were clearly far below aspiration.
